title: stamp.py record-class comment counts three regexes over six and cites two moved paths
claim: The comment above tools/release/stamp.py:RECORD_CLASS_RES says the node copy carries 'the same three regexes' and lives at .claude/workflows/policy_lint.mjs, and register_argv's docstring cites tools/audit/README.md's section 'A harness at the evidence tag may measure the tag, not your tree'; at the baseline RECORD_CLASS_RES holds 6 regexes, .claude/workflows/policy_lint.mjs does not exist (the copy is tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs), and no tools/audit/README.md exists.
